title: Maximum Subarray (Kadane)
statement: Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous subarray (containing at least one number) which has the largest sum and return its sum.

examples.explanation: The subarray [4,-1,2,1] has the largest sum 6.

hints: If the running sum becomes negative, does it help any future subarray?
Keep track of currentRunningSum = Math.max(nums[i], currentRunningSum + nums[i]).

solutions.title: Quadratic Prefix Sums
Kadane's Linear Scan

editorial.approach: Kadane's algorithm: maintain a running current sum curr and a global maximum best. For each number x, decide whether to extend the previous subarray or start a new subarray at x: curr = max(x, curr + x). Update best = max(best, curr). Initialize best = nums[0] to handle all-negative arrays correctly.
editorial.why_optimal: Computes the optimal contiguous sum in a single O(n) pass with O(1) space, avoiding all O(n^2) subarray evaluations.
editorial.pitfalls: Initializing best = 0, which fails on arrays containing only negative numbers (e.g. [-5, -2, -8] would incorrectly return 0 instead of -2).
